scope: All current non-DeerFlow model-facing boundaries plus compatibility summaries of Stage-1 research calls, mapped from the current working tree atop the recorded git commit. The normalized whole-architecture census below replaces those broad Stage-1 summaries with the canonical 42-family DeerFlow 2 subsystem inventory, including the default one-owner actor-intelligence completion pass. Deterministic actor coverage, contract finalization, context/role projection, profile serialization and READY/runner validation are data passes rather than LLM families. Generated deer-flow copies are not counted twice; DeerFlow 1.x is excluded.

normalized_census.count_formula: 51 baseline non-research current records in this file + 5 added logical-operation detail records + 2 Stage-1 transport dispatch helpers in this file + 42 detailed DeerFlow 2 families in deerflow2/deerflow2-call-inventory.json
normalized_census.why_not_79_plus_42: Twenty-one broad research logical summaries in call_sites overlap the detailed DeerFlow 2 bridge families. They remain for backwards-compatible whole-pipeline lookup but are excluded from the normalized census, so the two files must not be naively added.

counting_semantics.static_site: A checked-in source location that directly dispatches to a model, model wrapper, or model-hosting framework.
counting_semantics.logical_invocation: A semantically distinct prompt/response operation that may share one generic dispatch site with other operations.
counting_semantics.realized_calls: Runtime provider requests depend on cache hits, retries, fallback, loop counts, section counts, actor counts, rounds, tool iterations, configuration, and early stopping. The multiplicity field records that rule instead of inventing a fixed total.
counting_semantics.not_llm_but_model: Embedding and reranking boundaries are included because they are learned-model calls even though they are not chat completions.

transport_contracts.contract: Content-addressed cache may return with zero provider requests. Otherwise chat performs up to three primary application-level attempts. If configured, one fallback client performs up to three more attempts and cannot recurse. Authentication and non-retryable failures can stop earlier; OpenAI-compatible SDKs may add their own internal retry behavior. Telemetry and run-budget checks occur after success.

Calls application chat, locally repairs/parses JSON, and on parse failure resends once at lower temperature. Therefore one logical chat_json call is zero provider requests on a cache hit, normally one successful chat, and at most two chat calls; with application fallback this is at most twelve application-level provider attempts, excluding SDK-internal retries.

OpenAI-compatible tools= request with at most three application-level attempts. It has no CLI/provider fallback because CLI transports cannot accept native tool schemas. The report caller catches failure and switches to the ReAct path, whose model turns use application chat and its fallback chain.

DeerFlow client stream owns the lead-agent/model/tool loop. Each streamed turn is admitted through a cross-process model lease, bounded by recursion_limit and research-budget controls, and can invoke the lead model repeatedly as tools and subagents return observations.

Creates a no-tools/no-thinking chat model and invokes it once per logical synthesis, extraction, or judge operation. Provider SDK bounded retries are internal. Eligible transport/quota/content failures open a process-local primary circuit and try one explicitly configured fallback model; later parallel calls route directly to that fallback during the cooldown.

The shared Track-B actor dossier synthesizer and judge directly construct and invoke one tool-free model under the global model lease. Provider-internal retries may still apply, but these calls do not traverse the bridge tool-free helper's explicit primary/fallback circuit. The landscape, cast-wide completion and targeted gap-research families instead use transport.deerflow.stream.

Graphiti requests structured extraction through application chat_json. Small and medium work can use the fast tier. A schema-echo correction loop tries temperatures 0.0 and 0.4; Graphiti has an outer retry policy. One Graphiti logical operation can therefore expand through adapter correction, JSON resend, application provider retry/fallback, and Graphiti outer retries.

OASIS SocialAgent/CAMEL uses either an OpenAI-compatible CAMEL model or a CLIModel adapter for Claude/Codex CLI. env.step is the checked-in application boundary; the dependency may perform more than one completion for an agent when its internal tool/action loop requires it.

call_sites.output: Executive synthesis/summary used in the stitched dossier.

call_sites.output: Complete research report text.

call_sites.output: Structured replacement sections/append operations.

call_sites.input: Question, depth/language and the 17-dimension actor/relationship/trajectory contract, including history, values, incentives, motivations, capabilities/constraints, operational preferences, alliances/opponents, decision authority/triggers, current actions, future plans, investments, track record, likely actions, red lines and knowledge state. Every admitted claim must carry an exact supporting quote/span, a current Track-B fetched-source receipt/content hash, separate source-publication and claim-valid dates, evidence type/status/horizon/confidence and qualifiers.
call_sites.output: Actor-landscape evidence notes, fetched-source/tool traces and query-bound stage1-search-result-receipt/v1 producer receipts for a force-ranked, semantically identified cast.
call_sites.receiver: The same isolated Track-B thread, then the mandatory cast-wide completion pass and dossier synthesis.
call_sites.persistence: Baseline actor thread/checkpoint, fetched-source/progress ledgers and eventual actor dossier artifacts.
call_sites.multiplicity: Exactly one logical opening landscape stream for the one baseline Track-B owner under checked-in defaults; zero only when dual track is explicitly disabled or before Track B is reached. Targeted judge-gap streams are counted separately by the detailed DeerFlow 2 family.

call_sites.input: The same Track-B checkpoint and candidate cast plus an always-scheduled cast-wide instruction to close all 17 dimensions for every Tier-1/2 actor; prioritize plans/actions/investments/decision rights/knowledge/leverage/preferences, bind claims to exact receipts and supporting spans, and record typed structured gaps after bounded query-bound attempts.
call_sites.output: Dense per-actor coverage notes and a per-actor/per-dimension ledger containing source-bound claims or typed gaps with attempt counts, result IDs, receipt IDs, exhaustion and reason.
call_sites.receiver: Tool-free actor-dossier synthesis, deterministic coverage audit and ten-dimension judge.
call_sites.persistence: Same isolated Track-B checkpoint/progress/source ledger; material is incorporated into actor_dossier.md and later actor-intelligence/v1.
call_sites.multiplicity: One logical streamed completion attempt for the one Track-B owner under checked-in defaults, regardless of whether the opening agent delegated; zero only when Track B itself is disabled/not reached. Transport failure is recorded, but cannot bypass the final deterministic coverage gate.

call_sites.input: The isolated actor thread's sanitized and non-executably delimited fetched landscape/completion evidence, forecast question, language and ontology-ready dossier/ACTOR_INTELLIGENCE_LEDGER_V1 contract; governing instructions and untrusted evidence are separate System/Human messages, while tools and thinking are disabled.
call_sites.output: Actor dossier prose, cast/network/timeline and a complete Tier-1/2-by-17-dimension accountable ledger with semantic actor identity, sealed source-bound claims, grounded relationships/causal attributes and typed gaps.
call_sites.receiver: Deterministic source-bound coverage audit, ten-dimension actor judge and version-3 global-synthesis manifest.
call_sites.persistence: actor_dossier.md, coverage/judge sidecars, meta hashes and final research contract.
call_sites.multiplicity: One initial synthesis plus one after each successful targeted gap-research round; with the default two-round bound, one to three logical calls when Track B reaches synthesis, otherwise zero on early failure/explicit disable.

call_sites.input: The whole-document-sanitized dossier, bounded only by the 200,000-character transport ceiling; PASS is impossible if any sanitized byte was truncated. The call also receives fresh source/receipt-bound coverage, question/language and the ten dimensions cast_correctness, salience_ranking, per_actor_depth, relationship_completeness, history_evolution, evidence_grounding, contradiction_handling, ontology_readiness, forward_behavior_coverage and cast_wide_accountability in a separate governing System message.
call_sites.output: Strict JSON with exactly all ten finite 0-5 scores, PASS/FAIL, targeted gaps and a structured input attestation binding source, sanitized and exact judged bytes; malformed, non-finite, stale or truncated scorecards fail closed.
call_sites.receiver: Actor refine loop and dossier quality metadata.
call_sites.persistence: actor_dossier_judge.json when a scorecard exists, bound in lane meta, evidence_synthesis_manifest.json and the successful Stage-1 research contract.
call_sites.multiplicity: Default one to three logical calls for a non-empty dossier: one before each of up to two refinement decisions and one final post-refinement rejudge when the last candidate changed. Zero when the judge is explicitly disabled, a configured length-skip fires, the dossier is empty, or Track B is disabled/not reached. An explicit final FAIL is never admitted.

call_sites.output: Continuation text.
call_sites.multiplicity: Zero or one continuation per detected truncation event within caller bounds.

call_sites.input: Section with wrong-language residue, target language and protected citations/data.
call_sites.output: Language-corrected section.
call_sites.multiplicity: Zero or one per failed section language audit.

call_sites.input: Section conversation plus graph/search/statistics/interview tool schemas.
call_sites.output: Assistant content and zero or more tool calls.
call_sites.receiver: Tool executor; observations are appended to the next model turn.
call_sites.persistence: Agent log, tool trace and eventual section.
call_sites.multiplicity: One call per native-tool iteration until final content or iteration cap. A transport failure falls back to the ReAct loop.

call_sites.input: Native tool conversation and accumulated observations after iteration budget/end condition.
call_sites.output: Final section text.
call_sites.multiplicity: Zero or one final text call after the native tool loop when no final content was already returned.

call_sites.input: Section ReAct prompt, accumulated Thought/Action/Observation trace and tool instructions.
call_sites.output: Next action request or final section text.
call_sites.receiver: Regex action parser/tool executor or finalizer.
call_sites.multiplicity: One application-chat call per ReAct iteration up to the configured cap.

call_sites.input: Full bounded ReAct trace and instruction to emit the section without another action.
call_sites.output: Final section text.
call_sites.multiplicity: Zero or one after the ReAct loop if no acceptable final section was returned.

call_sites.input: User question, report context and chat history.
call_sites.output: Initial answer.
call_sites.receiver: Report chat API response or optional grounding revision.
call_sites.persistence: No durable chat history in this call path unless client supplies/stores it.
call_sites.multiplicity: One per POST /api/report/chat request.

call_sites.input: Initial answer plus retrieved report/graph evidence and correction instruction.
call_sites.output: Final grounded answer.
call_sites.persistence: Response only unless client stores it.
call_sites.multiplicity: Zero or one per chat request when evidence-grounding revision is selected.

call_sites.input: Final report, question, horizon/as-of, source/citation evidence and forecast schema.
call_sites.output: Scenario probabilities, criteria, confidence and forecast metadata as JSON.
call_sites.receiver: Forecast normalizer, consistency checks and persistence.
call_sites.persistence: forecast.json, report metadata and production ledger row.
call_sites.multiplicity: Normally zero because the default spine-first path reuses _forecast_spine. One fallback extraction from final report prose when spine construction is disabled, fails, or yields no usable spine, with chat_json resend/retry behavior.

call_sites.input: Binary forecast IDs/statements plus candidate market ID, question, current implied-YES probability and end date, with an exact/near resolution-equivalence rubric. Price history is not included in this prompt.
call_sites.output: Structured exact/near resolution-equivalence match decisions and mapping rationale; deterministic code constructs the accepted rich market_anchor objects.
call_sites.receiver: Binary reconciliation and deterministic anchor construction.
call_sites.multiplicity: Zero or one per forecast when binary events, eligible candidate markets and the anchoring flag are all present; this call decides mappings rather than consuming already-created anchors.

call_sites.input: Forecast/market probabilities, evidence and requirement to explain material divergence.
call_sites.output: Structured divergence decision/explanation.
call_sites.multiplicity: Zero or one when a material market divergence needs adjudication.

call_sites.input: Binary-extraction instructions; requested minimum count, themes and contrarian mode; research-dossier slice (or final-report fallback only if the dossier is absent); optional situation brief; pinned scenarios; horizon-year rule; and eligible market pack. Simulation enters only under legacy_prompt.
call_sites.output: A batch of newly created binary forecast contracts with probabilities, rationales and objective criteria as JSON.
call_sites.multiplicity: One initial batched draw; at most one shortage top-up; an optional contrarian/low-probability top-up; and one batched draw per configured secondary model. Market alignment and divergence enforcement are separate call records. It is not one call per individual binary event. Every extra ensemble report lane repeats the applicable sequence unless reused.

call_sites.input: Question, research actor forecast inputs, situation brief, scenarios/base rates, market pack, horizon/as-of context and probability contract. Under default diagnostic_only policy the simulation signal pack is explicitly empty; simulation enters only under a separately promoted legacy policy.
call_sites.output: One complete forecast spine JSON draw.
call_sites.receiver: Self-consistency aggregator and report evidence spine.
call_sites.persistence: Forecast-spine metadata and final structured forecast.
call_sites.multiplicity: Normally K calls where K=REPORT_SPINE_SELFCONSISTENCY_K (default 1). If the first draw is empty, one extra retry precedes the remaining K-1 draws, so a configured K can realize K+1 logical calls.

call_sites.input: Draft mutually exclusive scenario forecast spine, evidence omissions and calibration rubric; this operation does not critique the binary-event set.
call_sites.output: Structured critique/corrections.
call_sites.multiplicity: Normally one scenario-spine red-team/self-critique pass before prose under checked-in defaults; zero when disabled or when no draft spine is available.

call_sites.input: Draft forecast and instruction to imagine failure, identify missed mechanisms/signals, and propose corrections.
call_sites.output: Structured premortem findings.
call_sites.multiplicity: Zero under checked-in defaults; at most one per forecast when REPORT_PREMORTEM is externally enabled.

call_sites.input: Ephemeral provider/model/base URL/API-key settings and a small probe prompt.
call_sites.output: Connectivity success/model response or sanitized error.
call_sites.persistence: Explicitly none; configuration is not saved by the test endpoint.
call_sites.multiplicity: One user-triggered probe, with the selected transport's retry behavior.

call_sites.input: Configured provider/model and small readiness prompt.
call_sites.output: Probe result used in readiness report/admission.
call_sites.multiplicity: One per requested provider probe; no pipeline is started by the standalone check.

call_sites.input: Report prose and five-dimension evaluation rubric.
call_sites.output: JSON evaluation scores and findings.
call_sites.persistence: Evaluation-only output; not production forecast calibration.
call_sites.multiplicity: One only when the explicit live-LLM evaluation flag is supplied; default CI does not call it.
